messages.content: Give a compact description of a calm morning.
Soft light reaches the room, the street stays quiet, and a warm drink cools beside an open notebook.
A brass key rests on a folded map while a blue cup keeps the corner from curling.
Write one sentence about careful measurement.
A careful measurement records the instrument, unit, uncertainty, and conditions so another person can reproduce it.
It makes the result easier to check and reproduce.
Produce a deliberately overlong fixture response.
